verdict.rationale: Increase has a dedicated webhooks page describing outbound callbacks to your application when events occur, a List Events API as a polling alternative, and special real-time webhooks for card authorization decisions. The Ramp case study says Ramp ingests webhooks for each step of the ACH transfer lifecycle. The Ascend 'no webhook support' quote describes that customer's earlier situation, not Increase, so it does not contradict this. Missing for 10: documented details on how webhook endpoints are registered and how event types are selected, signature verification and retry semantics, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor-hosted case studies.
